subject: Urgent: Protective pricing clause for Q4 surge — VP/CFO clearance needed
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: temporary surge safeguard for Horizon Labs (need VP/CFO clearance)

Team — quick summary and ask below. Horizon (prospect->POC->fast ramp) has requested a short-term protective pricing clause: they want an onboarding rate lock and an overage cap during their expected Q4 usage spike. Key constraints: they will commit to a 12-month starter commitment (monthly min $45k), but predict a 3-week burst where usage could be 3x baseline in week 2.

Why this matters: Horizon is strategic (AI-compute heavy, potential multi-cloud ISV partnership). If we decline the temporary cap they will pause expand decision and push to a competitor with a lower overage ceiling.

Proposed internal concession (what sales suggests):
- Temporary Surge Safeguard: cap overage unit price at $0.075 per 1k tokens for the first 30 days after go-live (normally $0.12).
- Volume commitment: 12-month commitment at $45k/month (minimum).
- Protective offset: if actual usage in month exceeds 200% of baseline, Horizon will accept a 30% deferred credit applied to the following quarter invoice (caps at $150k total).
- Clause expiry: automatic reversion to standard rate after 30 days; CFO/VP signoff required for the credit ceiling and cap.

Attachments: Horizon_SOW_v3.pdf (SOW draft), surge-protection-pricing-model.xlsx (model with scenarios).

Ask: Vivek — can you evaluate margin impact and indicate whether CFO signoff is required to approve the cap and deferred-credit ceiling? Marissa — can you draft a one-paragraph memo for VP/CFO that summarizes risk/reward and recommended signoff? Naomi — if we get signoff, please prepare a one-pager for procurement and DocuSign flow.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: temporary surge safeguard for Horizon Labs (need VP/CFO clearance)

Thanks Markus — added context and suggested language for the memo below. I also flagged the DocuSign envelope fields that must be conditional on the cap.

Short memo (suggested for VP/CFO):
Horizon Labs is a strategic enterprise prospect whose initial 12-month starter commitment (monthly minimum $45k) justifies a one-time, 30-day limited surge safeguard to secure go-live and expansion momentum. The proposed cap ($0.075/1k tokens for 30 days) reduces expected unit margin by ~22% in the event of a full surge; however, the capped exposure is offset by (a) a $150k maximum deferred-credit ceiling, and (b) the likelihood of multiyear expansion given Horizon's product roadmap. We recommend approving the temporary cap and $150k credit ceiling contingent on finance registering the exposure and legal adding a sunset clause and usage audit rights.

DocuSign note: include a conditional credit-application clause (auto-expire) and require procurement signature.

Mark to Vivek: please confirm margin impact (%) in the table below and advise whether this requires explicit CFO-level authorization or VP commercial clearance is sufficient.

Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Alice Reynolds <alice@horizonlabs.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@horizonlabs.com
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 08:34:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: temporary surge safeguard for Horizon Labs (need VP/CFO clearance)

Markus / Marissa — appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple clarifying points from procurement side before we go to legal/DocuSign: 1) We ask the cap to be for 45 days (instead of 30) to cover the full ramp window; 2) procurement wants the deferred credit to be applied automatically with clear reconciliation mechanics (no later than 60 days post-burst); 3) we will accept a maximum deferred credit of $200k if we can extend the cap to 45 days.

We're willing to sign the 12-month commitment today if we get the 45-day cap + $200k deferred credit ceiling.

If it helps, I can jump on a 20-min call to close this out tomorrow morning.

Best,
Alice Reynolds
Head of Partnerships — Horizon Labs
alice@horizonlabs.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2026 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: temporary surge safeguard for Horizon Labs (need VP/CFO clearance)

Quick finance readout after reviewing the model and downside scenarios in surge-protection-pricing-model.xlsx:
- Baseline margin at committed rates: ~48% gross contribution.
- If we accept 45-day cap at $0.075/1k and $200k deferred-credit ceiling, worst-case P&L exposure over first quarter is ~$145k in gross margin reduction (before dilution effects of retention).
- The $200k ceiling increases downside volatility vs. the $150k ask; exposure is material but bounded within our deal-level risk thresholds for strategic accounts.

Recommendation: CFO signoff required for any deferred-credit ceiling > $150k. VP commercial can approve $150k/$0.075 cap for 30 days. For Horizon's ask (45 days / $200k) I can provisionally approve from a bookkeeping standpoint, but I need explicit CFO approval to finalize legal language that creates a deferred-credit obligation beyond $150k.

Next steps:
1) Marissa — finalize one-paragraph memo (use the suggested wording above) and tag for VP/CFO.
2) Markus — tell Horizon we can meet them at 30 days/$150k pending CFO review for their 45 days/$200k request; offer a 20-min call to negotiate the midpoint.
3) Naomi — prepare DocuSign with conditional fields for the 30-day/150k fallback and separate CFO-only approval path to activate the extended terms.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Finance — Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
